question: How big was the corpora they trained ELMo on?

evidence: For the experiments described below, we trained our own ELMo models from scratch. For English, the training corpus consisted of the English Wikipedia dump from February 2017. For Russian, it was a concatenation of the Russian Wikipedia dump from December 2018 and the full Russian National Corpus (RNC). The RNC texts were added to the Russian Wikipedia dump so as to make the Russian training corpus more comparable in size to the English one (Wikipedia texts would comprise only half of the size). As Table TABREF3 shows, the English Wikipedia is still two times larger, but at least the order is the same.

answer.free_form_answer: 2174 million tokens for English and 989 million tokens for Russian
